tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tse'u dmar rgyal gsol 'khrul bral zhal bzang bzhugs so// tse dmar gsol mchod bya tshul stegs bu khebs ldan la 'bru bkram khar rta mgrin gtor ma g.yas su sman/ g.yon du rak+ta/ de'i 'og du dbus su ya ba skya bdun btsan gtor/ g.yas su sman/ g.yon du rak+ta/ mdun du drag mchod/ de'i phyir chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod/ gzhan yang gser skyems/ spyan gzig sogs gang 'byor dang / thugs chog sogs nas 'byung ba'i gsol kha'i chas sogs bsham la sbyangs bdug byas te/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi kā pa la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shap+ta'i bar 'bru gsum spel ba'i mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthar/ dharma ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pas byin dbab/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa nas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o bar lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya de'i ched du khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma/ klu brgyad bsnol ba'i steng du hrīḥlas pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal dmar po g.yon zhal ljang gu g.yon zhal dkar po/

zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa zhal bgrad pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ smin ma dang / sma ra dang / dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa dbu gsum gyi gtsug na rta mgo gsum kha gdangs shing / rta skad 'tsher ba/ rngog ma'i gseb nas me stag 'phros pas stong gsum gang ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje/ gnyis pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gsum pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi dang po na sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pa na mdung thung / gsum pa na rgyu zhags 'dzin pa/ glang chen gyi ko rlon dang zhing chen gyis g.yang gzhis stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ mi skra'i tshangs skud dang / khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu'i brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas pa bzhi bskums zhing / g.yon pa bzhi brkyangs pas klu chen po brgyad sbrul gyi rnam par brdzis pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du bzhugs pa/ de'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad rta mgrin tshon gang pas go mtshams med par gtams pa/ rang dang de thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra 'brug stong ltar sgrog cing me dpung 'bar bas gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad gzhob thul thul bsreg par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma ta krita badz+ra kro dha ha ya gri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya stong la sogs pa bzla'o/ /bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra dun bh+yoḥ tig nan hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥs ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya bzlog sa ma ya bh+yoḥ sa ma ya btubs/ sa ma ya byer/ sa ma ya rbad/ sa ma ya rbad rbad phaṭa ya 'byung po mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ ces pa'i drag sngags 'di yang nyer gcig tsam re bzlas pa'i mthar/ phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ bde bar gshegs pa sogs dang / myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

bdud rtsi/ a mri tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu gdung pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i nang du go gu da ha na las sha lnga/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ bh+rūṃ aṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ hūm̐ las ye shes lnga'i ngo bo rnams gsal ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po rnams brtsegs pa las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu bas rlangs pa yig 'bru gsum la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang 'bru gsum las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams 'bru gsum dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par byon nas rdzas steng gi yig 'bru gsum la thim pas/ yig 'bru brjid dang ldan pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu ba sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur nas/ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ de bzhin gtor ma'ang byin brlabs/ rak+ta'i snod a las thod pa yangs par ra las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ zhes byin brlabs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma klu brgyad bsnol ba'i steng du hrīḥlas pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur ba las khro'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa rtsa zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ljang gu/ g.yon zhal dkar po/

zhal re re la spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal bgrad pa mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ smin ma dang / sma ra dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ dbu gsum gyis gtsug na rta mgo ljang gu gsum kha gdangs shing rta skad 'tsher ba rngog ma'i gseb nas me stag 'phro bas stong gsum gang ba phyag drug gi g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje/ gnyis pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gsum pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi dang po na sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pa na mdung thung / gsum pa na rgyu zhags 'dzin pa/ glang chen gyi ko rlon dang zhing chen gyis g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ mi skra'i tshangs skud dang / khrag gi thig le zhag gi zo ris thal chen gyi tshom bu'i brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas pa bzhi bskums zhing g.yon pa bzhi brkyangs pas klu chen po brgyad sbrul gyi rnam par brdzis pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du bzhugs pa/ de'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad rta mgrin tshon gang pas go mtshams med par gtams pa/ de thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra 'brug stong ltar sgrog cing / me dpung 'bar bas gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad gzhob thul thul bsreg pa'i sku can du gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñcha hūm̐/ zhes gsung shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las bla ma'i ngo bo 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma ta krita badz+ra kro dha ha ya gri wa hu lu hū lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/

sarba sha trun bigh+nan ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum sogs kyis gtor ma bsngos/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza pad+ma he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra sogs sngon du 'gro bas chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rnams pra tīts+tsha swāhā'i mtha' can gyis mchod/ mtshan sngags la ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes btags pas sman raka gis mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hrī spyan ras gzigs sprul hrīḥlas khro bo'i sku/ /chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos/ /log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral pad+ma dmar po'i steng / /'khor ba'i 'dam skems tsha zer rgyas pa'i sku/ /dug lnga'i rang bzhin klu chen gdan steng du/ /brkyangs bskums rol pa'i bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro la rjes chags sku mdog dmar ba'i mdangs/ /log 'dren tshar gcod rtsa zhal mche ba gtsigs/ /g.yas sngo g.yon dkar khro dang 'dod pa'i nyams/ /sku gsum zhal ldan khyed la༞ /dus gsum gzigs pa'i spyan gsum nyi zlar 'khyil/ /dug gsum tshar gcod mche gtsigs ljags 'dril bzhad/ /khams gsum dbang sdud skra smin sma ra 'bar/ /sna tshogs nyams ldan khyed la༞ /rta mgo ljang khu drag pos sgra dbyangs kyis/ /gnas gsum ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang sdud cing / /gdon bgegs log 'dren kun gyi snying rab 'gas/ /srid gsum g.yo mdzad khyed la༞ /rngog ma'i gseb nas me stag 'phros pa yis/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu yongs khyab pas/ /ye shes me dpung rwa ba bla re gur/ /bar chad kun 'jom khyed la༞ /phyag drug g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /me 'bar ral gri 'phyar ba'i stang stabs kyi/ /ma rig bdud dpung phye mar 'thag mdzad pa'i/ /mthu stobs bsam yas khyed la༞ /g.yon gsum sdigs mdzub mdung thung rgyu zhags kyis/ /gdug can gzir dang nyon mongs kun 'bigs shing /

/bgegs kun 'ching zhing snod bcud dbang sdud pa'i/ /dgos pa dpag med khyed la༞ /pha rol phyin drug dag pa'i phyag rgya drug /'khor 'das dpal 'byor stsol ba'i rin chen brgyan/ dug lnga'i klu 'dul sbrul gyi chun po sogs/ /rgyan kun 'dzin pa khyed la༞ /glang lpags zhing chen stag gi sham thabs sogs/ /ru tra dpa' bkong na bza' lhab lhub gsol/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i gzi 'od kyis/ /snod bcud zil gnon khyed la༞ /dgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung ba yis/ /bzhad pa'i nga ros rgyal kun mchod pa dang / /sgrub la mchog stsol ma rung phyer 'thag pa'i/ /pad+ma dbang chen gsung la༞ /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba'i rol pa yi/ /'gro la brtse dang log 'dren tshar gcod cing / de steng zung 'jug ngang las ma g.yos pa'i/ pad+ma dbang chen thugs la༞ /khyod kyi yon tan dgos 'dod dbang rgyal dang / /phrin las sna tshogs nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /'khor ba ji srid sems can don mdzad pa/ /thugs rje che ldan khyed la༞ /de ltar khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa la/ /rtse gcig dad pas mchod dang bstod pa'i mthus/ /bstan 'gro phan bde bum pa bzang po ltar/ /nam yang mi nub rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ /sngon gyi las sam 'phral rkyen las gyur pa'i/ /sdig sgrib nad gdon byed kha rbod gtong sogs/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /khyed sku bsgom zhing gzungs sngags bzlas pa dang / /mi 'gyur bde chen ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i mthus/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor lung rtogs yon tan sogs/ /mthun rkyen ma lus rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /bstan 'gro'i don chen yun du bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bdag gi srid zhi dge legs ma lus kun/ /khab len rdo yis lcags phye bsdus pa ltar/ /'bad med dbang du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ /khyed ni rgyal ba'i drag po'i phrin las te/

/de phyir zhi ba'i mi thul dgra bgegs kun/ /skad cig nyid la thal ba rdul du rlog /mi mthun phyogs kun 'joms par mdzad du gsol/ /mdor na deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bdag sogs 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i yid can tshogs/ /khro rgyal rta mchog rol pas rjes bzung nas/ /gnas skabs mthar thug legs tshogs ma lus stsol/ /de nas chos skyong gyi zhi mchod gong bzhin byin brlabs/ drag mchod bsangs sbyangs nas/ zhu ba las byung ba'i bar gong bzhin la/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag gi ar+ghaṃ/ dbang po'i me tog tshil chen gyi bdug pa/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus zhal zas/ rkang gling rol mo rnams dwangs shing sogs gong bzhin/ sman raka gtor gsum byin rlabs gong bzhin/ gser skyems gong bzhin spyan gzig sogs la dmigs nas thal mo khong stong / swa bhā wa sogs mdzod rgya sngags bcas/ 'khyil sngags rgya bcas/ mchog sbyin mnyam bzhag oṃ a ka ro sogs nas a d+ya nut+pan+na twad oṃ āḥswāhā/ g.yon khu tshur/ g.yas khu tshur las mdzub mo bsgreng ba dang / oṃ dz+nyā na sogs na maḥs man+ta sogs dbang bsgyur gyi sngags rgya ste/ sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs/ mdzod rgya dang / oṃ sarba bid pū ra sogs nas badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ gis spel la/ rten yod med ci ltar yang bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las btsan yul bzang thang dmar po zangs brag gnam la bsnyegs pa/ rtse la rgod smug lding ba/ logs la btsan skya rgyu ba/ sked na gcan gzan ngur ba/ rtsa bar dug chu 'khol ba brag ri dmar po'i nang du khrag mtsho 'khol zhing bse mkhar smug po zangs kyi sgo lcags can btsan mkhar 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus na tri bdun yongs su gyur pa las lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po tse'u dmar sku mdog dmar ljang ral pa dmar po me 'od 'khrigs pa/ spyan nas me'i skar mda' 'khrug pa/ zhal nas khrag gi ser chen 'bebs pa/

mche ba rnon po gangs ri ltar gtsigs pa/ ljags glog ltar 'khyug pa khro zhing 'jigs la rngam zhing gtum pa/ sku la dar dmar gyi ber chen za 'og sngo khra'i gong lag can gsol ba rin chen gser gyi ske rags bcings pa/ dbu la dar dmar gyi thod can/ stag dong g.yas dang gzig shub g.yon du 'phyangs ba/ bse phub dmar po rgyab du 'khyil ba/ phyag g.yas btsan gyi zhags pa dmar pos dgra bo 'ching zhing / g.yon bse mdung dmar po dar dmar gyis ru mtshon can snying la bsnun pa/ rta bra bo sgab nag dar gdan dmar po sga khra bo dngul gyi yob thag zangs kyi yob chen gser gyi srab/ g.yu'i mthur mda'/ dar dmar gyi srab skyogs/ sbrul nag gi gong smad byas pa la bcibs nas stong gsum bskor ba/ sku la zhal gyi lha btsan sku mdog dkar khro gtum can sku la za 'og dmar khra'i gos dang dar dmar gyi thod gsol ba/ g.yas stag dong dang g.yon du gzig shub 'phyang ba/ phyag gnyis gser mda' gzhur bkang ste dgra bo'i snying la bsdig pa/ smug po sha gdongs sga srab can la bcibs pa/ gro shod bod kyi sgang dmag rje sku mdog dmar po me 'od 'bar ba rngams shing 'jigs pa sku la leb rgan gyi 'jol ber dang dar dmar gyis thod bcings pa/ stag dong g.yas dang gzig shub g.yon du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yon zangs zhags dmar pos dgra bo bcings te g.yas kyi shang brdeg pa/ mtshal lu rting dkar sga srab can la bcibs pa/ ra tsa gos sngon gyi klu btsan sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs su rung ba/ sku la chu dar sngon po'i ral gu la dug sbrul gyi ska rags bcings pa/ dar sngon gyi thod can stag dong g.yas dang gzig shub g.yon du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas lcags mdung nag po dang g.yon dug sbrul gyi zhags pa 'phen pa/ rta ser po sga srab can la bcibs pa rdo rengs dmar pos grib btsan sku mdog dmar po 'jigs pa'i gzugs can ber dmar gyi slog pa dang /

dar dmar gyi thod gsol ba/ stag dong g.yas dang g.yon du gzig shub 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas bse mdung dmar po dang g.yon btsan gyi rgyu zhags bsnams pa/ rkyang dmar sbo dkar sga srab can la bcibs pa/ kam ka thod nag bdud btsan sku mdog ljang nag shin tu 'jigs pa/ sku la dar nag ber chen dang bdud dar nag po thod du bcings pa/ stag dong g.yas dang g.yon du gzig shub 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas dar nag gi ru tshon 'phyar zhing / g.yon pas 'breng zhags bla la 'debs pa/ rag pa gzhung nag sga srab can la bcibs pa/ rtsal thog rgyug gi grib btsan sku mdog khrag ltar dmar ba sku la zangs khrab dmar po dang dbu la dar dmar gyi thod bcings pa/ stag dong g.yas dang g.yon du gzig shub 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas bse mdung dmar po me 'od 'phro ba gsor zhing / g.yon zangs kyi ral gri glog ltar 'khyug pa/ rta mchog rlung gi gshog pa sga srab can la bcibs pa/ bdun ka'ang ri khyi spyang ki rol du khrid pa/ ri bya pho rog steng du lding ba/ btsan dmag 'bum sde'i 'khor gyi bskor ba dang bcas bzhugs/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling dang 'phags yul me 'bar gyi dur khrod/ li yul lcags ra smug po/ dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang / dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang la sogs pa nas gnod sbyin tse'u dmar po/ lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po/ gnod sbyin yang le ber/ kun khyab drag po rtsal 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bcom rol bsangs lugs phan bde kun 'byung sh+lau ka dang por/ hūm̐ 'dren pa gzhan la med pa bcas sh+lau ka gsum la hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin ma'i dbyangs gsum brdeg len can bcas tshar gsum/ phyi rabs dus su nas rgyun bzhin bcas/ hūm̐ phan bde kun 'byung bstan pa rin po che/ /g.yel med srung ba'i chos skyong yid bzhin nor/

/mthu ldan kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /glog ltar myur bas thugs rjes gshegs su gsol/ /sngon tshe thub pa'i dbang po rta mgrin gyis/ /dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur dam tshig phog /bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i chos skyong gnas 'dir byon/ /de rjes slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /dbang bskur gsang ba'i mtshan gsol bsam yas sogs/ /bod yul gtsug lag khang gi srung ma ru/ /bka' bsgos bzhin du gnas 'dir da ltar byon/ /phyi rabs dus su chos rje bla ma dang / /sa skya lo tsā la sogs bstan 'dzin gyi/ /skyes chen mang pos 'phrin las mgon po ru/ /mnga' gsol zhal bzhes dran pas da byon cig /khyad par snyigs dus bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog /sprul pa'i skyes chen sngags 'chang chos kyi rje/ /ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis/ /bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyi grub pa yi/ /bstan pa'i nyams gso mtha' dag mthar phyin tshe/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rin po che/ /bsrung zhing skyong ba'i gnyer gtad bka' bsgos shing / /zhal bzhes ji bzhin ma thogs myur du byon/ /des na dang po bcom ldan rta mgrin bka'/ /de rjes slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas bka'/ /de nas 'khon gdung rim par byon pa'i bka'/ /ji ltar bsgos shing 'phrin las bcol ba ltar/ /da lta sngags 'chang bdag gi nyer bskul gyis/ /bstan pa 'jig la thug pa'i dus 'di la/ /thugs rje mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dpung bskyed nas/ /skad cig nyid la yud kyi gshegs su gsol/ /zhes brjod cing rol mo gsum brdeg dang / chems brdung gi rjes su che ba gnyis brdab la bzhag de nas 'dur gdangs dang bcas pas 'di skad du/ hūm̐ ka ba keng rus mi mgo'i rtsig pa can/ /kha bad lcang los byas pa'i drag po'i gnas/ /ga pur spos dkar gsur dud sprin ltar gtibs/ /nga yi srung ma gnas 'dir gdan la bzhugs/

/chems brdung mthar gsum brdeg len can/ phyi mchod ni rnga brdung mgon po 'khor dang ma'i dbyangs rol gsum brdeg len can bcas rigs 'gre shes par byas la/ hūm̐ lha yi mchod yon dam pa 'dis/ /gnod sbyin mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /ces par dbyangs rol 'dur shur gang rung gi oṃ shrī dharmā pā la ma hā yak+ṣa rā dza sa pa ri wā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ya swāhā/ gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa/ de bzhin du lha yi zhabs bsil sogs/ mchod tshig so sor rang rang gi sngags dmigs bsal sgyur dgos ma gtogs gzhan tshang ma dbyangs rol yod med kyi rnam gzhag bcas gong gi rigs 'gre shes par bya/ chu gnyis nyer mchod rol mo rnams rdzogs nas/ srid zhi'i phun tshogs dpal ster ba'i/ /'khor lo nor bu btsun mo blon/ /glang chen rta mchog dmag dpon ste/ /rin chen sna bdun khyed la 'bul/ /dbyangs rol gong bzhin/ /mtshan sngags 'dra/ sap+ta rat+na pra tīts+tsha ya swāhā/ rnga brdung dang rol mo 'dra 'og ma rnams la'ang shes par bya'o/ /gzugs mdzes sgra snyan zhim pa'i dri/ /ro brgya'i bza' btung bde mchog gi /reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas/ /gnod sbyin tse'u dmar mnyes gyur cig /mtshan sngags la pañca ka ma gu ṇa pra tīts+tsha ya swāhā/ gzhan yang bkra shis byed pa'i rtags/ /'khor lo dpal be'u bum pa dang / /pad+ma dung dkar gser gyi nya/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan khyed la 'bul/ /mtshan sngags la aṣ+ṭa maṅga la dra bya pra tīts+tsha ya swāhā/ phyi mchod ste/ rtags brgyad mchod sngags kyi swāhā'i rjes kyi gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa rdzogs na zhwa gyon sbraṃ sbraṃ sbraṃ 'then skang gsum/ gsum brdeg len can/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer tsha rtsub 'phros/ gnod sbyin bskul bas sprul pa yang sprul sogs kyi bsgral las mdzad par bsams la rnga phyir brdung gi dzaḥ

wa'/ wa'/ wā'aya/ dgongs shig tse'u dmar shul drag can/ /bstan 'gror sdang pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /sangs rgyas dngos su rdzu ba dang / /bla ma mkhan dang rgyal blon btsun/ /pha ma nye 'brel la sogs pa/ /legs brdzus nyes pa 'khrid pa dang / /gdug cing gtum pas dngos su rgol/ /phyi nang gsang gsum gar gnas kyang / /da lta nyid du 'dir khug la/ /'jigs rung shul drag mtshon cha yi/ /drag tu bsnun la lus sems steng / /ya nga'i mnar gcod sdug bsngal thong / /srog chod dbugs long sha khrag rus/ /lpags sogs bza' btung rgyan gos gyis/ /zhes pa'i bar dam tshig chen po'i 'chams dbyangs rol mo bcas la bcu gcig rdung med par gsum brdeg len can rdzogs nas chems rdung / mtshan sngags kyis mthar sarba sha trun bagh+nin mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsum brdeg len can/ rnga rol bzhag la/ nang mchod ni/ dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyis/ /rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rab 'khyil ba/ /lbu ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa yis/ /ar+ghaṃ mchog gi mchod pa 'di/ /phrin las mgon po gnod sbyin che/ /tse'u dmar 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang / /bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /oṃ shrī dharmā pā la ya ma hā yak+ṣa rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ma hā rak+ta sa mu dra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du shes par byas la/ gzhan tshang ma 'phags pa rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi lnga mchod bzhin/ gdangs/ phyag rgya sngags dbyangs/ rnga rol sogs phyag len bzhin/ ma hwa pañca a mṛ ta ba liṃ ta pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ bar chems brdung rjes kyi gsum brdeg len can rdzogs nas rnga rol bzhag oṃ hrīḥyak+ṣa rā dza sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ bhu dza kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba sha trun bigh+nan mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdun sogs kyi gtso 'khor rnams la gtor ma bsngos/ chos skyong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bskang rdzas kyi mchod gtor rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sogs nas sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol par rgyun bzhin/

'phrin las mchod pa'i dbyangs rnga brdung bcas/ zag med bde ba kun gyi mdzod/ /mchod pa'i lha mo'i 'dod yon lngar/ /gnod sbyin tse'u dmar dgyes dgur rol/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /zhes bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs dang snyoms 'jug mdzad par bsam la/ gsum brdeg len can mthar chems brdung mtshan sngags mthar/ de wi a nu ra ga pra tīts+tsha ya swāhā/ zhes dang gsum brdeg len can/ hūm̐ ca re bshams pa'i mchod gtor spyan gzigs dang / /cha lang rnga dang rkang gling rol mo'i sgra/ /ja chang sha khrag bza' btung sna tshogs pa/ /nya phyis la sogs snod bzang bkang ste 'bul/ /gang thugs ma thung ba'i dbyangs rol/ ta la'i ljon 'dra'i yid 'phrog mchod pa'i rdzas/ /tha mal blo 'das zhing khams kun gang bar/ /da lta blo yis sprul ste srid mtha'i bar/ /na rga skye 'chi spang pa khyed la 'bul/ /pa re pu re'i chags sdang blo ngan 'dis/ /pha mas brgyud pa'i bsrung mas thugs 'gal ba/ /ba glang lta bu bdag 'dras 'gyod pas bshags/ /ma lus byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /tsa tur las kyi mdangs ldan dar zab dang / /tsha grang gdung skyob srog chags lpags pa'i tshogs/ /dza re rak+ta 'dzag pa'i mgo phreng dang / /wa dang spyang ki rta g.yag bya nag tshogs/ /zha nye ma 'dres dngul sogs rin chen dang / /za ma bcud ldan tshogs 'khor ri ltar spung / /'a 'ur snyan brjid dbyangs kyi nga ro dang / /ya rab dgyes pa'i yo byad bsam mi khyab/ /rā hu la sogs las mkhan rngam pa'i tshogs/ /la se seng sogs gos bzang mtshar du dngar/ /sha khrag rus pa'i dmar gtor ri rab tsam/ /sa gzhi ri klung bkang 'dra'i mthun rdzas 'di/ /ha ha'i bzhad sgra sgrog pa khyod la 'bul/ /a yig don ldan chos kyi gnas lugs mchog /bla ma yi dam chos skyong rang sems rnams/ /dbyer med shes pa'i lta bas rgyas btab pas/ /snang ba 'gag med lhag bsam dmigs pa'i 'phrul/ /bstan srung kun du dgyes pa'i mchod sprin 'di/

/sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyen po dang / /da bcol legs pa'i gsol 'debs chen por 'bul/ /dgyes pa'i bzhes nas rnal 'byor bdag cag la/ /da dung bstan pa 'dzin pa'i slob bu'i tshogs/ /rigs dang chos las skyes pa mang 'phel nas/ /sngags 'chang yab sras bstan 'dir cher rgyas mdzod/ /kha ba ri 'di'i rgyal po rgyal phran dang / /'bangs rnams 'khor bcas de yi lha srung kun/ /bdag cag brgyud par bcas pa'i dbang 'dus nas/ /ljongs 'di sa skya'i bstan pas khyab par mdzod/ /dad brtson shes rab snying rjer ldan pa yi/ /bstan pa 'dzin nus gang zag thams cad kyang / /'khrul zad gong ma'i bzhed gzhung snod gyur te/ /de rgyun dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel bar mdzod/ /dad pa dman cing dge bas blo gros dman/ /chos la 'jug pa'i skal ba chung rnams kyang / /bstan dang bstan 'dzin mchod la spro ba'i blos/ /kun kyang dkar po'i las la 'jug par mdzod/ /bdag cag rnams la bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyis/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dam nyams dgra bgegs rnams/ /mthu ldan khyed kyis lo zla ma 'gyangs par/ /chos dbyings bsgral te gnod pas mi tshugs mdzod/ /deng sang bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa ni/ /'bab chu zad pa'i rdzing bzhin nyin re 'phri/ /'di 'dra bka' srung rnams kyis ma gzigs sam/ /log sgrub mtha' dag myur du tshar gcod mdzod/ /sngags 'chang bdag cag dpon slob yon bdag bcas/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /phyi ma lhan cig dag pa'i zhing bgrod nas/ /slar yang sprul pa'i bstan par rgyas pa mdzod/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang / /rin chen dkon mchog gsum gyi byin brlabs dang / /chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu'i mthu rtsal gyis/ /sngar bzhin yid la re ba kun 'grub mdzod/ /bar rgyun bzhin/ hūm̐/ mthu ldan kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /khyed ni sngon tshe 'og min chen po ru/

/zhe sdang me dpung 'bar pa'i klong dkyil du/ /rak+ta chags pa'i rba klongs 'khrug pa'i dbus/ /dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor na/ /bcom ldan rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po nyid/ /khams gsum dbang sdud ting 'dzin nyid la bzhugs/ /de tshe dug lnga chos nyid ngang rol pa'i/ /bdud dang dmu dang btsan dang rgyal po dang / /gying dang gnod sbyin mthu ldan grangs med dang / /stobs ldan rtsal drag ldan pa khyed kyang 'dus/ /de ltar rta mgrin dregs pa'i 'khor rnams kyis/ /gdug rtsub kha rlangs mthu yi nad mtshon gyis/ /bskal pa'i 'jig rten stong par nye ba'i tshe/ /rta mgrin 'khor gyi khrod nas mkha' 'gro ma/ /rdo rje pad+ma khro dbang rgyal po la/ /gsol ba btab pas bcom ldan rta mgrin gyis/ /gtum po'i rtsa sngags 'brug ltar bsgrags pa las/ /'khor gyi dregs pa thams cad 'dar zhing dngangs/ /de tshe dregs byed kun dang gnod byed gtso/ /tse'u dmar khyod la bcom ldan rta mgrin gyis/ /dbang bskur dam tshig phog nas sangs rgyas kyis/ /bstan pa srung bar khas blang dam bcas shing / /de rjes slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /rgya gar dur khrod chen po me 'bar gyi/ /gnya' ri dmar nag gru gsum rngam pa'i dbus/ /srin mtsho 'khol ma me lce ris kyi 'gram/ /brag dmar srin po lang 'dra'i sgrub gnas su/ /slob dpon chen po rtse gcig sgrub la gzhol/ /de tshe dus gcig tshe na srod kyi char/ /spyang ki khrag gi ral can bdun byung ste/ /de dag ngu bzhin pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /gnod par brtsams tshe slob dpon chen po yis/ /rta mgrin rgyal po'i ting 'dzin rab brtan pas/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje 'phyar bas gcan gzan rnams/ /rta mchog zhon pa'i skyes bu bdun gyur te/ /slob dpon nyid la phyag btsal bzod gsol nas/ /bdag ni gnod sbyin rgyal po tse'u dmar te/ /sngon tshe bcom ldan khro rgyal rta mgrin gyis/

/dbang bskur dam tshig phog nas sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs de nyid yin/ /rgya gar yul du gnod sbyin tse'u dmar zhes/ /yongs su grags shing bod yul gangs khrod na/ /mthu ldan lha btsan zhes su 'bod de mchis/ /de ltar gsol te pad+mas bka' bstsal pa/ /khyod kyi gnas dang srog snying gang yin smros/ /slar yang gnod sbyin rgyal pos 'di skad gsol/ /bdag gi gnas ni 'phags yul 'di nyid dang / /gtsang gi seng phug bya ba de yang lags/ /pha ni dmu rje legs pa zhes bya dang / /ma ni btsan rje zla ba thod dkar gyi/ /bu mo gnod sbyin bzang 'gran ma zhes bya/ /srog gi snying po sngon tshe rta mgrin gyis/ /dam btags tshe na gsungs pa'i bka' dri ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro rdo rje pad+mas bsdus mdzad pa'i/ /rgyud chung gang de brag ri chen po 'dis/ /stod phyogs brag ri srub ldan 'di yi nang / /bse las byas pa'i ga'u sen gang pa/ /de na yod kyi longs spyod mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gi sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srung ma bgyid/ /de ltar gsol bas pad 'byung rab dgyes te/ /zab mo'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur te/ /gsang mtshan kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /zhes btags rgyud kyang gter nas spyan drangs te/ /gnod sbyin khyed nyid slob dpon srung ma mdzad/ /de nas gu ru pad+ma bod yul du/ /byon pa'i dus su glog ltar myur ba yi/ /rta mchog zhon pa'i skyes bu bdun dag gi /mnga' ris dpal thang nas bsus bsam yas kyi/ /mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang / /'gran zla bral ba'i gnas mchog de nyid bar/ /skyel dang bsu ba'i phrin las cher sgrub pas/ /slob dpon dges pa'i gsung las gnod sbyin gyis/ /rgyal po tse'u dmar gnas pa'i yul de ni/ /gnas mchog de na nges par yod ces gsungs/ /phyis dus 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / /khyad par bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang rje/

/ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis/ /bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa yis/ /gtsug lag khang chen rnams kyi nyams gso dang / /dge 'dun 'du ba'i chos grwa gsar 'dzugs sogs/ /bstan pa'i me ro gso bar mdzad tshe yang / /stobs ldan gnod sbyin khyod kyi phrin las kyi/ /rnam sprul du mas bstan 'dzin bstan par bcas/ /'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad ces yongs grags la/ /des na dang po bcom ldan rta mgrin dang / /bar du slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas zhabs/ /mtha' mar 'khon ston sa skya'i rje btsun mchog /rim par byon pa rnams dang khyad par du/ /sngags 'chang bla ma'i bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /spyir gyi bstan dang khyad par sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa rin chen 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phyir/ /rin chen thod snod mkha' ltar yangs pa'i nang / /sha khrag gtor ma ka ra shing tog sogs/ /ro bcud ldan pa'i bza' ba ri ltar spung / /khrag zhag chang dang rgya ja la sogs pa'i/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil/ /ga pur gur gum tsan dan dkar dmar dang / /spos dkar la sogs dri zhim thu lu lu/ /ngo mtshar spos dud sprin ltar thibs se thibs/ /gzhan yang mda' mdung ral gri shang lang sogs/ /rno ngar ldan pa'i mtshon cha bgrang yas dang / /khrab rmog zhib sogs go cha bsam mi khyab/ /gser dngul byi ru mu tig mu men dang / /pad raka margad la sogs rin chen tshogs/ /kha thi ding phon la si seng la sogs/ /gos dang dar zab mang pos sa gzhi khengs/ /seng ge stag gzig dom dred 'phar ba dang / /gung dang spyang khyi la sogs gcan gzan tshogs/ /rta nag rting dkar glang chen ma he dang / /shwa ba gna' ba bse ru dgo ba gnyan/ /g.yag rgod stobs ldan ra lug mang po dang / /rma bya ne tso khu byug ngang pa sogs/ /spu sdug yid 'ong ldan pa'i bya yi tshogs/ /srog chags rnams kyang dbang po kun tshang zhing / /rin chen rgyan spras bu yug 'tshub pa tsam/

/gzhan yang bkra shis rtags brgyad rin chen bdun/ /bum bzang dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /yid bzhin nor sogs dngos 'byor yid sprul gyi/ /mchod sprin sa dang bar snang khyab pa 'di/ /gnod sbyin tse'u dmar zhes su yongs grags pa'i/ /'phrin las mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /kun kyang tshim zhing rab tu dges gyur gcig /da ni 'dod pa'i 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ /sngags 'chang bdag gi lhag bsam rnam dag 'di/ /sngar bzhin 'bad med yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /rnal 'byor bdag la bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyis/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dam nyams dgra bgegs rnams/ /lo zla ma 'gyangs snying khrag thang la 'phos/ /lus sems 'khrol la rnam shes dbyings su sgrol/ /bskul lo rbad do gnod sbyin mthu ma chung / /snang srid dbang bsdus phrin las rab rgyas mdzod/ /gzhan yang rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /tshe mthar phyin cing bsam don kun 'grub ste/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid dpal 'byor rnams/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs brgyud dri med kyis/ /rgyun chad med par bstan pa 'dzin pa dang / /dbus gtsang khams kyi 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /dbang du 'dus shing don gnyis lhun grub mdzod/ /grangs gsog yod med gang rigs/ grangs gsog byed na dang po yongs rdzogs rgyun bzhin la chems brdung med pa/ gnyis pa sogs nas grangs ji gsog bar/ spyir gyi bstan dang khyad par sa skya pa'i nas/ don gnyis lhun grub mdzod bar la grangs bzung / rjes mar chems brdung sbraṃ gcig gnyis/ zhes dang dbyangs rol bcas/ hūm̐ byin rlabs thugs rje'i bdag nyid bla ma dang / /dngos grub myur du stsol mdzad yi dam lha/ /bar chad kun sel bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /bdag la gsan cing dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /khyed rnams rang bzhin cir yang ma grub kyang / /log rtog 'khrul pa'i dbang gis de dang der/

/zhen cing 'dzin pas bden par sgro btags te/ /ma rig las ngan bsags pa mthol lo bshags/ /snang ba'i ngo bo bskyed rim lha yin kyang / /ma dag tha mal 'dzin pas sgrib gyur te/ /bskyed rim sgom dang sngags kyi bzlas brjod la/ /g.yel zhing bag med gyur pa mthol lo bshags/ /chos rnams rang bzhin stong zhing bdag med kyang / gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bag chags zhen pa yis/ /rdzogs rim bde chen phyag rgya chen po la/ /kun rtog dri mas gos pa༞ /bsrung bar bya rgyu dbang bzhi'i dam tshig la/ /le lo brjed nges bag med dbang gyur pas/ /mnyam gzhag rjes spyod bza' srung mi 'bral ba'i/ /dam tshig rnams dang 'gal ba mthol lo༞ /khyad par chos skyong srung ma'i sku gsung thugs/ /dam tshig nyams chags mchod gtor chag pa dang / /bsnyen sgrub ma nus bag med spyod pa yis/ /gtsang sbra chung dang 'bags btsog phud nyams shing / /rgyu chung bshams nyes dam rdzas ma tshang dang / /sku yi rnam pa mi gsal sngags ma dag /gnyid dang bre mo'i gtam gyis dus 'da' zhing / /ting 'dzin lhod dang bsgom la mi brtson pas/ /tha mal yid g.yengs 'dzab bzlas nyung ba dang / /mdor na lus ngag yid kyi spyod pa rnams/ /rang bzhin bcas pa'i kha na ma mtho ba/ /bgyis dang bgyid stsal bgyi pa'i las rnams dang / /lung du ma bstan nongs pa gang bgyis kun/ /rab tu gnongs shing 'gyod pas bshags lags na/ /dmigs med thugs rje'i klong du bzod par gsol/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dag par byin gyis rlob/ /grangs gsog yod med gang rung / 'phrin bcol ni/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ /rmi lam ltas sdig skal ba ngan pa dang / /nad dang gdon dang dus min 'chi la sogs/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /bdag cag rnams la phan par gang sems pa/ /de dag kun gyi tshe dang bsod nams dang / /'khor dang longs spyod mthu dang dbang phyug sogs/ /rtag tu mi nyams rgyas par mdzad du gsol/

/lha dang mi dang klu dang gnod sbyin sogs/ /'gro ba kun gyi gdug pa'i sems zhi nas/ /thams cad bdag gi dbang du gyur nas kyang / /theg mchog bstan pa'i snod du 'gyur bar mdzod/ /sngon las 'phral rkyen las byung gdug pa can/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin gtsug lag dgon gnas 'jig /skye 'gro kun dang bdag la sdang ba yi/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /zhes pa lta bu rang rang blo bstun bstan 'gro spyi bye brag la phan pa'i 'phrin bcol dang / khyad par bsam yas pe har lcog tu gzugs can la 'khrul med brlams par gsol ba lta bu yin na/ khyod kyi dang po bcom ldan rta mgrin dang / /bar du slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas zhabs/ /tha mar gsar bka' gdams sa dge sogs rnying bka' gter dag snang rgyud 'dzin mkhas grub ji snyed tshogs/ /rim par byon pa rnams dang khyad par du/ /sngags 'chang bla ma'i bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /sde brgyad rba klong 'khrug pa'i lcog chen du/ /skal bar ldan brlams lung gsal 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces pa lta bu'i 'phrin bcol grub nas gsol kha ni/ gtor ma che ba'i g.yas su sha dmar po'i dum bu dgu dang chang phud gtsang ma bzhag g.yon du phye mar dang khrag chab bzhag mdun du las kyi rdo rje zhig gis lcags snod gtsang ma'i nang du g.yas nas sha re/ g.yon nas phye mar mtheb skyu re bcug gsol kha tshar la de 'dra ba lan gsum gtor chen la btab cing / g.yas g.yon nas khrag chang yang thigs re blug rnal 'byor pa gzhan rnams kyis rol mo'i bye brag kun thogs nas/ mdun gyi gtor rdzas dgra bgegs kyi sha'i ri bo/ khrag gi rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i gram khrod chen pos stong gsum thams cad khyab par bsam/ de rnams tse'u dmar 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal dmar gnam tsam gdengs pa'i nang du sib kyis btab pas hab thob tu bzhes nas thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas mnyes nas/

bdag gi bcol ba'i las thams cad thogs pa med par sgrub par bsam la/ dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ mgon po'i mtshan gsol gnod sbyin tse'u dmar che/ /rgyal ba'i bstan bsrung bka' yi bya ra ba/ /gdug pa tshar gcod drag shul mthu rtsal can/ /bdud 'dul dpa' bo gnod sbyin 'khor bcas rnams/ /bdag cag rnams la brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ /'dod yon rgya chen gtor ma rgya mtsho dang / /longs spyod sna tshogs zhal zas mchod pa 'di/ /phrin las mgon po tse'u dmar 'khor bcas la/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis mchod pa dam par 'bul/ /dges pa'i sems kyis mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /sngon gyi thugs rje 'phrin las nyer dgongs la/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams zhi ba dang / /'dod don mthun pa'i rkyen rnams 'grub pa dang / /thub pa'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas 'dur dbyangs bya zhing / hūm̐/ dpal ldan mgon po dmar po/ /sa gsum dbang phyug chen po/ /rgyal ba'i bka' bsrung dam pa/ /lha srung yongs kyi ded dpon/ /dur khrod kun gyi bdag po/ /rig 'dzin yongs kyi srog shing / /rnal 'byor kun gyi dgra lha/ /bstan pa yongs kyi bya ra ba/ /dug gsum gyi nad kyi sman pa/ /bdud 'dul rnams kyi dpa' bo/ /dmu rje legs pa'i sras mchog /gnod sbyin tse'u dmar po/ /lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po/ /gnod sbyin yang le ber/ /kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /dam nyams kun gyi srog gcod/ /mna' zan kun gyi gshed ma/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs kyi bdud po khyed kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi khā hi/ ces brjod cing / gtor bsngo nas 'byung ba'i gtor sngags dang / bsnyen sngags gsal 'debs pa la lan gsum rol chen dang bcas pas gsol kha dang po btab/ yang sngar bzhin bshams la/ gzhan yang yab rje dmu rje legs pa/ yum chen gnod sbyin bzang 'dren ma/ gsang yum gangs dkar sha med/

bdud btsan nag po/ lha btsan dkar po/ brag btsan dmar po/ klu btsan mthu bo/ dri btsan mon mo thu ru rgyu/ bdud 'dul gyi dmag dpung nyi khri chig stong / lha dmag bye ba dung phyur/ phyogs skyong zhing skyong / mdun gyi shugs 'dren/ g.yas g.yon gyi ru 'dren/ rgyab kyi rjes nyul/ skyo gsang / a tsa ra'i tshogs/ spre'u'i tshogs snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi zhal du oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mchod pa dam pa 'bul zhing gsol lo/ /mchod do/ /rol chen dang / a ka ro'i sngags mang du bzlas la gsol kha gnyis pa btab/ yang bshams la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' dang bstan pa rin po che la dgongs te/ khyed rnams kyis dgyes shing mos pa'i thabs kyis bzhes la rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi nad dang gnod pa gdon bgegs thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ tshe dang bsod nams dang / dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par spel/ dbang phyug dang nus mthu bskyed/ snyan pa dang grags pa sgrub/ dregs pa'i 'gro ba pho mo thams cad dbang du bsdus/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad thal ba rdul du rlogs cig gzhan yang bdag cag rnams kyi rgyags chad kyi ma dang / blo lhag gi pha mdzod cig rgyab kyi slog pa dang / mdun gyi 'khar ba mdzod/ nyin gsum gyi bya ra dang / mtshan gsum gyi mel tshe mdzod/ yo na srongs/ 'gyel na slong / chad na mthud cig ral na tshems shig stor na tshol la/ brjed na bskul cig mgo gang gi yar la bstod la/ dkyus gang gi mar la srings shig gzhan yang legs pa brgya dang sprod la/ nyes pa stong dang bsnol cig bsam pa yid bzhin du bsgrub la/ re ba rgya mtsho lta bur bskongs shig mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol la/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bzlog cig gnod byed kyi dgra bgegs bzlog pa'i ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan la brtan par bzhugs te/

dgra dpung bcom la bgegs dpung thams cad bshig cig dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon 'phyor cig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs bstod cig gzhan yang spo la dar 'phyor la/ khrom du dung bus shig gtam ngan rgyun chod la/ snyan grags 'jig rten du sgrogs shig dam chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan nam mkha' la 'phyor/ mtho ris dang thar pa dang byang chub sgrub pa'i mgon grogs mdzod cig skyabs dang / dpung gnyen dang / brten dang / gling mdzod cig bdag cag gi ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin bcol ba'i phrin las thams cad myur du sgrubs shig gong gi gtor sngags lan gsum/ a ka ro rol chen dang bcas pas gsol kha gsum pa btab/ slar yang de 'dra ba tshang ma tshar gnyis te yongs dril tshar gsum rdzogs pa dang / de dag gi lhag ma lus pa rnams kyang btab/ de nas mnga' gsol/ dpangs bstod rgyas par bya ba ni/ sh+lau ka gnyis la stong nyid ma'i bu dbyangs rol mo bcas pas/ kyai pad+ma dbang gi bka' nyan cing / /srid zhi'i dregs pa ma lus pa/ /kun gyi gtso bo gnod sbyin che/ /kun khyab drag rtsal dgongs su gsol/ gsang mtshan/ /tse'u dmar po dgongs su gsol/ rgya gar yul gyi mtshan/ /mthu ldan lha btsan dgongs su gsol/ bod yul gyi mtshan rnying pa/ /de ring khyed la mnga' gsol lo/ /gnod sbyin chen po dpangs bstod do/ /sngon tshe pad+ma dbang chen gyi/ /spyan sngar khas blang dam bcas bzhin/ /bstan srung chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /rgya gar dur khrod me 'bar du/ /rgyal dbang pad+mas dam la btags/ /dam can chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /'phrin las pho nya mdzad pa'i phyir/ /pho nya chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /mi 'gyur sku mdog smug nag zhal/ /gtum drag rngams pa srin po'i gzugs/ /'jigs byed chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams/

/dbu 'phang bstod dang bsrung ba'i phyir/ bsrung ma chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /bse rmog me 'od 'bar ba dang / /bse khrab sdig pa'i lus can sogs/ /che btsan chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong ba'i phyir/ /phyag g.yas mdung dmar phyogs bcur 'phyar/ /dpal mgon chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /dbang drag las rnams sgrub pa'i phyir/ /g.yon pa btsan zhags dmar po bsnams/ /btsan rgod chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /stag ral gzig shub la sogs pa/ /dpa' bo'i chas kyis rnam par bkra/ /mthu stobs chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /gang bcol 'phrin las sgrub pa'i phyir/ /zhabs la sag l+h+wam yu ring gsol/ /phrin las mgon po༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /rig 'dzin tshe dpal bskyed pa'i phyir/ /mu men byi ru'i do shal 'phyang / /gzi brjid chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /snang srid chos kun gsal ba'i phyir/ /dngul dkar me long thugs dkar mdzes/ /ye shes chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /stong gsum yud kyis bskor ba'i phyir/ /rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs/ /myur mgyogs chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /khams gsum srog la dbang bsgyur phyir/ /'khor du dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /srog bdag chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por༞ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin bcas/ /bu bzhin skyong ba'i ngang tshul can/ /dam tshig chen por༞ /gnod sbyin chen por dpangs bstod do/ /lha mi'i longs spyod phun tshogs dang / /phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas rnams/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin brlabs nas/ /ri dang rgya mtsho mnyam pa ru/ /'khor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /khyed kyi spyan lam 'byung gyur cig /'di ltar khyed la mnga' gsol bas/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang mchog /ri rab rtse ltar mtho bar mdzod/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams/ /dpag bsam shing ltar rgyas par mdzod/

/'jig rten bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /bum pa bzang po lta bur mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi bsam pa'i don/ /'dod 'jo'i ba mchog bzhin du mdzod/ /phrin las rnam bzhi bcol ba'i las/ /ma rmos lo tog lta bur mdzod/ /mdor na rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka'/ /bstan srung khyed kyi khas blangs bzhin/ /gnas skabs mthar thug re smon kun/ /yid bzhin nor bu khyed kyis stsol/ /de'i rjes su bskul zhing rbad dgos na gnad bskul ni/ hūm̐/ mthu ldan kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /sngon tshe 'og min cho 'phrul bstan zhing du/ /rta mchog rol pa'i dbang bskur dam tshig phogs/ /bka' bsgos khas blangs dran pa'i dus la babs/ /bar du rgya gar dur khrod me 'bar du/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma kā ra'i drung / /srog gi snying po phul zhing dam la btags/ /bstan srung khas blangs dran pa'i dus la bab/ /phyi rabs dus su 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa dang / /chos rje bla ma la sogs sngags 'chang rje/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas pas dus kun tu/ /mchod gsol phrin bskul dran pa'i dus la bab/ /khyad par sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po yis/ /bsam yas nyams gso gsar bzhengs mdzad pa'i tshe/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa srungs shig ces/ /gnyer gtad bka' bsgos dran pa'i dus la bab/ /da lta lnga bdo rtags tsam 'dzin nye'i dus/ /mi rnams phal cher mi dge bcu la spyod/ /khyad par bstan dgra gzugs can gzugs med sogs/ /kha zas bzang po dug dang bsres pa ltar/ /mdzes pa'i zol gyis ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa ston/ /rnam dag bstan pa'i mjug 'di rnyog mar byas/ /bstan 'dzin rnams kyi sku tshe'i mdzad 'phrin bkums/ /dge 'dun sde rnams bshad sgrub nyams su bcug /nyes med sems can sdug bsngal rgya mtshor 'phangs/ /mi bdag bdag re'i stobs ldan 'byung po 'gas/ /ya nga'i 'phrul gyis 'gro kun rmongs su bcug /gnod sbyin tse'u dmar khyed 'khor bcas pa la/

/dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas tho 'tshams shing / /yang dag bstan dang de 'dzin skyes bu la/ /log par lta ba'i gzugs can gzugs med kun/ /ma thogs myur du sgrol ba'i dus la bab/ /khyed kyi mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bsam yas kyi/ /dam nyams phyi nang gsang gsum dgra bgegs kun/ /gzungs shig chings shig sgo gsum gru gu ltar/ /khug cig drongs shigs khar rje dbang thang kun/ /phye cig gnon cig gnyen dang stobs 'byor tshogs/ /chod gcig skrod gcig srog dang srung skyobs rnams/ /chom shig sdigs shig rigs brgyud yul 'khor bcas/ /thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rin po che/ /da lta lhag ma tsam 'di mi bsrung na/ /rim gyis nub tshe bsrung bya gang yin de/ /ji ltar legs par bdag la gsung du gsol/ /bde sdug phal cher las la rag las pas/ /sems can las dbang bcos su mi btub na/ /las min zhig tu bab par mi 'gyur bas/ /thugs rje'i srung skyob des kyang ci zhig 'tshal/ /bstan pa bsrung zhing 'jig rten mi skyong na/ /sngon gyi khas blangs dam bcas de nyid gang / /drag shul nus pa de yang rdzun du 'gyur/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma slus par mi 'gyur ram/ /gnas gzhi 'di tsam bsrung ba'i mthu med na/ /sngon tshe pad+mas bod kyi gtsug lag khang / /bre tsam yan chad bsrung zhes bka' bsgos pa/ /me long has btab ji bzhin 'gyur ta re/ /bstan la gnod byed byung tshe mi sgrol na/ /dregs byed yongs kyi ded dpon mdzad nas su/ /stong gsum 'dul ba'i mthu rtsal yod do lo/ /khro gtum stong sgra des kyang dgos pa ci/ /de bas dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i gzugs can gzugs med kyi/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs log par lta ba kun/ /khyod kyi mi thub gang yang med pas na/ /myur du drag po'i las kyi tshar gcod mdzod/ /nam mkha' stong pa la ni tshad ma 'dzugs/

/'jig rten phyi ma la ni dus ma 'debs/ /rang bzhin grub pa'i skye 'chir 'khus ma 'debs/ /las dbang btsan ces tha snyad ma 'dogs par/ /bcol ba'i phrin las myur du sgrub par mdzod/ /rgyal bstan de 'dzin bcas pa dar ba dang / /'jig rten khams 'dir bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /khyad par mi 'gyur lhun grub rten brten par/ /dge 'dun sde 'bangs bcas pa dar zhing rgyas/ /mdo sngags chos tshul dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel/ /bsam pa'i don kun chos bzhin 'grub pa dang / /nag phyogs rtsad nas gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /tshig rol dgu brdung gsum brdeg len can/ sku gzugs sogs yod na brtan bzhugs ye dhar sngon 'gro rab gnas kyi gzhung rnams nas 'byung ba bzhin la/ bye brag tu yang rten 'di la dpal 'phrin las kyi mgon po gnod sbyin tse'u dmar po 'khor dang bcas pa brtan par bzhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs sogs nas/ yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las dang sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ bar tshar gang 'grub/ me tog char dang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas byas mthar/ dril bsil gdangs bcas 'gro la bde skyid sogs smon lam gang shes skabs su babs pa rnams dang / bkra shis kyi tshig du ma brjod mthar rol mo byas la spyi bskang gi 'phros yod na bya/ gong du bdag bskyed rdzogs nas 'di la btsan 'jus yin na rjes chog bya/ kha bskong gi 'phros ltar na/ yig brgya lan gsum/ nongs pa bzod gsol rten yod na brtan bzhugs/ med na gshegs gsol gnas gsum bsrungs/ dge ba bsngo/ bla ma yi dam chos srung gi bkra shis spyi dang / gang zhig yid bzhin nor bur gsol btab na/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsol ba ltar/ /dad pa can kun nam yang mi bslu ba'i/ /dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bkra shis shog /sna tshogs sku gsung thugs kyi sgyu 'phrul gyis/ /gang la gang 'dul mdzad 'phrin pha mtha' yas/

/dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba lhag pa'i lha/ /yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog /pad+ma rā ga'i lhun por tsha zer gyis/ /lan brgyar 'khyud 'dra 'jigs rung khyod kyi sku/ /gar dgu'i nyams kyis gdug pa kun 'dul ba/ /dbang drag rta mchog rol pa'i bkra shis༞ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i phrin las sgrub pa'i rigs/ /sna tshogs sku dang mdzad pa rgya mtsho yis/ /phrin las rnam bzhi 'bad med sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i༞ /khyad par gang gi mthu stobs me chen gyis/ /bar chad mi mthun tshang tshing kun bsregs nas/ /dge legs dpal 'byor snang ba'i 'od po che/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas༞ /mi mthun rgud tshogs chos nyid ngang du zhi/ /mthun rkyen phun tshogs 'bad med lhun gyis 'grub/ /bstan 'gror phan bde nyi ma'i 'od ltar gsal/ /phyogs dus kun du dge ba'i bkra shis shog/ //ces gnod sbyin chen po tse'u dmar mchod tshul 'di ni sa skya'i gdung rabs kha shas kyi gsung spyir btang mi gsal ba rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs par gzhan yang sbyar du rung ba'i gu yangs su sa skya pa kun blos rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu sbrul snron zla'i bsam yas mdo sde lha mchod bgyi bar dgos pa khyad par can zhig mthong nas sbyar ba'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ tsi'u dmar rgyal gsol 'khrul bral zhal bzang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
